name: lzma_next_strm_init
text:
#define lzma_next_strm_init(func, strm, ...) \
do { \
	return_if_error(lzma_strm_init(strm)); \
	const lzma_ret ret_ = func(&(strm)->internal->next, \
			(strm)->allocator, __VA_ARGS__); \
	if (ret_ != LZMA_OK) { \
		lzma_end(strm); \
		return ret_; \
	} \
} while (0)
